title.ja: 電話・ビデオ通話で日程調整
title.en: Setting up a meeting on a call

summary.ja: 時差を考えながら打ち合わせの日時を提案し、決めた内容を確認する。
summary.en: Suggest a meeting time across time zones and confirm what you agree.

setting: A short video call in early November between someone in the Tokyo office and Laura Bennett, a client in London, to book a one-hour video meeting about renewing their contract in the week of 9 November.

roles.persona: A member of the Tokyo office calling a client to arrange a meeting about renewing their contract.

levels.tutor: You are Laura Bennett, a client in London. Speak slowly and simply. Open by answering the video call with a friendly hello; wait for the student to say why they're calling. Say mornings are best for you. London is 9 hours behind Tokyo, so accept Thursday at 5:30 p.m. Tokyo time (8:30 a.m. in London); politely say no to the other free times, which are too early or too late in London.

title.ja: 電話の目的を伝える

hints: 来週の打ち合わせの日を決めたいと伝えましょう
I'd like to set up …
I'd like to set up a meeting for next week.

title.ja: 日時を提案する

hints: カレンダーを見て、日時を提案しましょう
How about … at … Tokyo time?
How about Thursday at 5:30 p.m. Tokyo time?

title.ja: 日時を確認する

hints: 決まった日時を確認しましょう
Great. So that's … at …
Great. So that's Thursday at 5:30 our time.

title.ja: 招待を送ると伝える

hints: カレンダーの招待を送ると伝えましょう
I'll send you …
I'll send you a calendar invite.

levels.tutor: You are Laura Bennett, a client in London, speaking at natural pace with a little small talk. Open by answering the video call with a friendly hello; wait for the student to say why they're calling. When asked when you're free, say mornings in London are best for you, any day next week. London is 9 hours behind Tokyo, so accept Thursday at 5:30 p.m. Tokyo time (8:30 a.m. in London); the other free times are too early or too late for you. Then ask how long the meeting will take.

title.ja: 打ち合わせの目的を伝える
title.en: Explain what the meeting is for

hints: 契約更新について話す打ち合わせをしたいと伝えましょう
I'd like to set up a call to …
I'd like to set up a call to talk about the contract renewal.

title.ja: 相手の都合を聞く

hints: 来週いつが空いているか聞きましょう
When are you … next week?
When are you free next week?

title.ja: 両方の時間で提案する
title.en: Suggest a time in both time zones

hints: 東京とロンドンの両方の時間で提案しましょう
How about … our time? That's … in London.
How about Thursday at 5:30 p.m. our time? That's 8:30 a.m. in London.

title.ja: 所要時間を伝える

hints: 打ち合わせの長さを伝えましょう
It should take about …
It should take about an hour.

title.ja: 招待を送ると伝える

hints: ビデオ会議のリンク付きで招待を送ると伝えましょう
I'll send you a calendar invite with …
I'll send you a calendar invite with the video link.

levels.tutor: You are Laura Bennett, a client in London, speaking at natural speed with some small talk. Open by answering the video call with a friendly hello; wait for the student to explain why they're calling. Mornings in London are best for you. When asked, say you're happy for the student's manager to join.

title.ja: 電話の目的を伝える

hints: 契約更新の打ち合わせを設定したいと伝えましょう
I'm calling to set up …
I'm calling to set up a meeting about the contract renewal.

title.ja: 両方の時間で提案する
title.en: Suggest a time in both time zones

hints: 東京とロンドンの両方の時間で提案しましょう
Would … Tokyo time work? That's … in London.
Would Thursday at 5:30 p.m. Tokyo time work? That's 8:30 a.m. in London.

title.ja: 新しい日時を確認する

hints: 決まった日時を、両方の時間で確認しましょう
Just to confirm: … Tokyo time, … for you.
Just to confirm: Friday at 8 a.m. Tokyo time, Thursday at 6 p.m. for you.

title.ja: 上司の参加を確認する
title.en: Ask if your manager can join

hints: 上司も参加していいか聞きましょう
Would it be okay if …?
Would it be okay if my manager joined us?

title.ja: 招待を送ると伝える

hints: 両方の時間を書いた招待を送ると伝えましょう
I'll send you an invite with …
I'll send you an invite with both time zones on it.

twist.tutor: Agree at first, then remember you'll be at a conference in New York all that week. New York is 14 hours behind Tokyo in November, so 5:30 p.m. Tokyo time would be 3:30 a.m. for you. Say so, and ask for another time; early evening in New York is fine. Accept Friday at 8 a.m. Tokyo time, which is Thursday at 6 p.m. in New York.

title.ja: 時差に合わせて別の時間を提案する
title.en: Suggest a time for New York

hints: ニューヨークとの時差を考えて、別の時間を提案しましょう
How about … Tokyo time? That's … for you.
How about Friday at 8 a.m. Tokyo time? That's 6 p.m. Thursday for you.

roles.persona: Laura Bennett, a client based in London.

levels.tutor: You are Yuki from the Tokyo office, calling Laura, a client in London. Speak slowly and simply. Open by saying hello on the video call; wait for Laura to answer, then say you'd like to set up a meeting next week. Ask when Laura is free. London is 9 hours behind Tokyo: suggest Thursday at 5:30 p.m. Tokyo time, which is 8:30 a.m. in London.

title.ja: あいさつに答える

hints: あいさつに答えましょう
Hi …! Good to …
Hi Yuki! Good to hear from you.

title.ja: 都合のいい時間帯を伝える

hints: 午前中がいいと伝えましょう
… are best for me.
Mornings are best for me.

title.ja: 提案を受ける

hints: その時間で大丈夫と伝えましょう
Yes, … is fine …
Yes, 8:30 is fine for me.

title.ja: お礼を言って電話を終える

hints: お礼を言って、あいさつしましょう
Thanks, Yuki. See you …
Thanks, Yuki. See you on Thursday!

levels.tutor: You are Yuki from the Tokyo office, calling Laura, a client in London, speaking at natural pace. Open by saying hello and that you'd like to set up a meeting next week. When asked, say it's about the contract renewal and will take about an hour. Ask when Laura is free, then suggest Thursday at 5:30 p.m. Tokyo time; give it in Tokyo time only, so Laura can check the London time (9 hours behind).

title.ja: 打ち合わせの内容を聞く
title.en: Ask what the meeting is about

hints: 何についての打ち合わせか聞きましょう
Sure. What's …?
Sure. What's the meeting about?

title.ja: 都合を詳しく伝える

hints: ロンドン時間の午前11時までならいいと伝えましょう
Mornings are best for me, …
Mornings are best for me, before 11 London time.

title.ja: ロンドンの時間を確認する

hints: ロンドンの時間で何時になるか確認しましょう
So that's … London time, right?
So that's 8:30 a.m. London time, right?

title.ja: 所要時間を聞く
title.en: Ask how long it will take

hints: どのくらいかかるか聞きましょう
How long do you think …?
How long do you think it'll take?

title.ja: リンクを送ってもらう

hints: ビデオ会議のリンクを送ってもらいましょう
Could you send me …?
Could you send me the video link?

levels.tutor: You are Yuki from the Tokyo office, calling Laura, a client in London, speaking at natural speed with small talk. Open by saying hello and that you'd like to set up a meeting about the contract renewal in the week of 9 November. When asked what to prepare, ask Laura to bring this year's order figures. Suggest Thursday at 5:30 p.m. Tokyo time (8:30 a.m. in London). When Laura can't make it and asks for an evening time, check the time difference (New York is 14 hours behind Tokyo in November) and offer Friday at 8 a.m. Tokyo time; let Laura work out the New York time (Thursday at 6 p.m.).

title.ja: 準備することを聞く

hints: 準備しておくことがあるか聞きましょう
Sure. Is there anything …?
Sure. Is there anything you'd like me to prepare?

title.ja: その週はニューヨークにいると伝える
title.en: Say you'll be in New York

hints: その週はニューヨークにいるので、その時間は難しいと伝えましょう
Actually, I'll be in … that week, so …
Actually, I'll be in New York that week, so that's too early for me.

title.ja: 夕方の時間をお願いする

hints: ニューヨーク時間の夕方にできないか聞きましょう
Could we do … my time instead?
Could we do early evening my time instead?

title.ja: 新しい時間を確認する

hints: ニューヨーク時間で確認しましょう
So that's … New York time. That …
So that's Thursday at 6 p.m. New York time. That works for me.

title.ja: 招待に両方の時間を書いてもらう
title.en: Ask for both times in the invite

hints: 招待に両方の時間を書いてもらいましょう
Could you put … in the invite?
Could you put both time zones in the invite?
